thread:
alex_w: FYI cert for eu1-edge (listener-prod-1) TTL showing expiry in ~45m, we've started seeing TLS handshake errors from a subset of clients. opened PR: https://git.redwood/infer/infra/+/PR-4827

deploy-bot: [ci] cert-rotation-eu1 start requested by alex_w. Job ID: job-4827. Canaries: enabled by default. Estimated rollout time: ~3m.

maria_r: looking. can we do a hotpatch push during the next change window?

alex_w: change window is broad today but this is high-severity, clients already failing. Requesting expedited approval + skip canary for speed (small config change: replace secret with new cert).

devon_ops: what's the rollback plan if something regresses?

alex_w: rollback = reapply previous secret `tls/eu1-edge:sha256:old` (we've kept old cert in secret backup). criteria to rollback: sustained 5xx rate >1% for 3m after deploy OR tls_handshake_failures metric increases by >50% over baseline for 5m.

sre_oncall: add monitoring alert runbook to be on pager for next 30m. i'll watch graphs and tcpdump.

release-manager: pinging approvals. @maria_r and @devon_ops please react with :white_check_mark: to approve skip-canary and expedited deploy. Need one ops + one release signoff.

maria_r: reviewed PR diff, change looks scoped to secret rotation only. :white_check_mark: approved for expedited roll.

devon_ops: I'm fine with skip-canary for this one given impact. leaving `max-unavailable: 1` and 60s probe. :white_check_mark:

release-manager: approvals received. Documenting deployment plan: 1) pin version tag `cert-rot-2026-03-20-01` in infra repo, 2) apply secret, 3) restart listeners gracefully `kubectl rollout restart deploy/eu1-listener -n prod --timeout=3m`, 4) observe metrics for 10m, 5) full traffic. If rollback criteria hit, revert secret and `kubectl rollout undo`.

deploy-bot: Authorization granted. Canary SKIP flag set by release-manager. Executing job-4827: rotating secret `tls/eu1-edge` -> `cert-rot-2026-03-20-01`. Logs streaming...

deploy-bot: [logs] Applying secret...
deploy-bot: [logs] Secret applied to namespace prod. Restarting pods (3 replicas), sequential restart to avoid downtime.

sre_oncall: seen a brief spike in 502s on one pod during restart, overall 5xx remains under 0.2%. continuing to monitor.

deploy-bot: Rollout completed on eu1 cluster. All pods `Ready`. Job duration: 1m52s.

alex_w: live traffic appears healthy, no client handshake errors in the last 8 minutes. thanks @maria_r @devon_ops for quick signoff.

release-manager: please add a short release note and tag the infra change `infra:cert-rot-2026-03-20-01` in release notes doc. also escalate to customer success for any customers we proactively notify.

alex_w: release note pushed to docs: "eu1 TLS certificate rotated to fix expiring cert causing intermittent client handshake failures. Hotfix rolled out 2026-03-20 14:02 UTC. No service impact post-rollout."

maria_r: marking this as "no-postmortem" for now since root cause is cert TTL. Will reopen if recurrence.

sre_oncall: staying on-watch for +20m then clear.

release-manager: closing thread after 30m watch window unless we see regression. :thumbsup:
